title: Deferred ownership cannot block retained offline purchases
expected_summary: Keeps ownership deferred as requested but recognizes retained offline purchases depend on it, requiring a boundary contract or renewed scope decision.

history.content: S1 — Inventory ownership. Offline sales need an authoritative owner; changing it later requires data migration. Recommendation: make the cloud authoritative for inventory. accept · edit · out of scope

turns.user: S1 is out of scope. Keep offline purchases in this release and finish the review.
assertions: Records ownership as deferred rather than accepted or resolved.
Recognizes that retained offline purchases depend on the deferred ownership decision.
Recommends a concrete boundary contract or explicitly explains why scope must change or the decision must return to scope.
Does not silently remove offline purchases against the user's instruction.
Does not declare the spec implementation-ready or start implementation while the dependency remains unresolved.
